newsitem.title: INDIA: India NSE stocks close lower in extended trade.
newsitem.headline: India NSE stocks close lower in extended trade.

text.p: Indian shares posted small losses on Monday at the National Stock Exchange (NSE) on the back of speculative selling by operators, traders said.

A technical problem at the NSE forced the exchange to suspend trade at 1115 hours (0545 GMT), NSE officials said. The bourse resumed trade at 1400 hrs and was open till 1700 hrs, 90 minutes beyond the usual closing time.
The 50-stock NSE index fell 4.15 points, or 0.45 percent, to a provisional close of 927.50, off 937.80, its intra-day high.
Lack of buyers ahead of the last day of weekly trade at the NSE on Tuesday put pressure on many blue-chip stocks, forcing them to close with minor losses, brokers said.
Reliance fell 1.90 rupees to 215.0 rupees, SBI 3.65 to 241.0, ACC 20.50 to 1,284.0, TISCO 0.90 to 180.90, and TELCO 5.25 to 352.75.
